newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BioTime started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BioTime started as buy.

text.p: Montgomery Securities said on Wednesday it initiated coverage of BioTime Inc with a buy rating and a 12- to 18-month price target of $55 per share.
-- Analyst David Crossen said the company was entering the "volume expanding" market, providing products given to patients who lost blood and needed the volume replaced.
-- He said his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate was a loss of $0.97 per share and his 1998 estimate was a loss of $1.30 per share. BioTime's earnings would show profit by 2000, he said.
-- "BioTime's products is more advanced than others in the market, and it will be marketed by Abbott Laboratories Inc," he said. "Abbott is a strong marketer."
